Mobility Flow 15-20min
• Cat-Cow 10x
• Hip 90/90 stretches
• Ankle mobility

💪 UPPER BODY (15-20 min)
🎥 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UyrYMWnXJ3k
   Mind Pump TV - 15 Min Beginner KB
• Pushups 3x8 (knees OK if needed)
• KB Rows 3x8 @ 18lb
• KB Overhead Press 3x8 @ 18lb


🦴 SPINE SESSION A (10-15 min) - FOUNDATION

🎥 Dead Bug: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I5z90fC9YpI
• Hold 8lb DB vertically, 3x6-8 slow reps/side

🎥 Suitcase Carry: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U5zrloYWwxw
• 18lb KB, 3x30sec/side

🎥 Hip Thrust: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LM8XHLYJoYs
• Glute Bridge 3x12 @ bodyweight

🏃 Easy Run
Rose Bowl Loop 0.75-1 lap (20-30 min easy)

💪 LOWER BODY (15-20 min)
🎥 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6xwGFn-J_QA
   Mark Wildman - Goblet Squat Tutorial
• Goblet Squats 3x8 @ 18lb
• Single-Leg DL 3x6 each @ bodyweight
• Reverse Lunges 3x8 each @ bodyweight


🦴 SPINE SESSION B (10-15 min) - FOUNDATION

🎥 Plank: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pSHjTRCQxIw
• 3x20-45sec, progress duration only

🎥 Bird Dog: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vKPGe2h3uag
• 3x6 slow reps/side, 2sec pause

🎥 KB RDL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V8VdYy7y3s8
• 18lb KB, 3x6-8 reps, slow descent

🏃 Easy Run
Arroyo Seco easy 30-40 min

🏃 LONG RUN: 3-4 mi
Lower Arroyo Seco out/back
Big breakfast 2hrs before. Water every 20min. Post-run meal <30min. Carbs 220-250g.

🚴 LONG RIDE: 75-90min
Chevy Chase climb easy pace
